notes: Estimated cost = partition list price x nodes x elapsed hours x the share of each node the job held (1 on whole-node partitions; cores or memory share, whichever is larger, on shared ones); it excludes boot/idle time and credits. Treat as an estimate.

commands: bash -c 'if sacct --helpformat | grep -qw Restarts; then SLURM_TIME_FORMAT=%s exec sacct -n -P --noconvert -o JobIDRaw,User,Partition,State,Reason,ExitCode,NodeList,NNodes,Submit,Start,End,ElapsedRaw,TotalCPU,AllocTRES,MaxRSS,Restarts,JobName "$@"; fi; set -o pipefail; SLURM_TIME_FORMAT=%s sacct -n -P --noconvert -o JobIDRaw,User,Partition,State,Reason,ExitCode,NodeList,NNodes,Submit,Start,End,ElapsedRaw,TotalCPU,AllocTRES,MaxRSS,JobName "$@" | sed '\''s/|/||/15'\''' clusterwand -a -S 2026-09-01
